title: UE-initiated NAS transport of messages accepted by the network

entities.name: UL NAS TRANSPORT message
entities.description: Uplink NAS transport message sent by UE to AMF containing payload container with various types of information.

entities.name: Payload container type IE
entities.description: Information element indicating the type of payload contained in the UL NAS TRANSPORT message.

entities.name: PDU session routing context
entities.description: Context stored by AMF containing routing information for PDU sessions including SMF ID, session type, and session parameters.

entities.name: PDU session ID IE
entities.description: Information element identifying the PDU session in NAS transport messages.

entities.name: Request type IE
entities.description: Information element indicating the type of PDU session request (initial request, existing PDU session, emergency request, etc.).

entities.name: S-NSSAI IE
entities.description: Single Network Slice Selection Assistance Information element used for network slice selection.

entities.name: DNN IE
entities.description: Data Network Name information element identifying the data network for PDU session.

entities.name: Old PDU session ID IE
entities.description: Information element containing the previous PDU session identifier during session reallocation.

entities.name: Additional information IE
entities.description: Optional information element providing supplementary routing or context information.

entities.name: Release assistance indication IE
entities.description: Information element indicating UE's expectation about subsequent data transmission patterns.

entities.name: SMF selection procedure
entities.description: Procedure performed by AMF to select appropriate SMF based on PDU session parameters, subscription data, and network policies.

entities.name: N1 SM information handling
entities.description: Procedure for handling N1 session management information in UL NAS TRANSPORT messages.

relations.description: UL NAS TRANSPORT message contains Payload container type IE that determines how the payload is processed.
UL NAS TRANSPORT message contains PDU session ID IE for session identification.
UL NAS TRANSPORT message may contain Request type IE indicating the type of PDU session request.
N1 SM information handling procedure establishes or updates PDU session routing context.
N1 SM information handling procedure includes SMF selection as a key step when no routing context exists.
SMF selection procedure uses S-NSSAI IE values and allowed NSSAI to determine appropriate SMF.
SMF selection procedure uses DNN IE values and subscription data to determine appropriate SMF.
Request type IE values determine the specific handling procedure for N1 SM information.
Payload container type IE set to 'N1 SM information' triggers N1 SM information handling procedure.
Presence of Old PDU session ID IE modifies the N1 SM information handling procedure for session reallocation.
